description: This file contains functions related to tensor sharding and distribution rules in PyTorch, specifically for einsum operations and pointwise tensor operations, including sharding propagation and resharding suggestions.

methods.name: _replace_char_in_str
methods.description: Replaces a character at a specific index in a string.

methods.name: _gen_reshard_suggestions
methods.description: Generates sharding suggestions for tensor operations based on input specifications and sharding maps.

methods.name: einop_rule
methods.description: Determines output sharding for einsum-like tensor operations, propagating sharding based on the equation and input specs.

methods.name: pointwise_rule
methods.description: Determines output sharding for pointwise tensor operations, handling broadcasting and sharding propagation.
